lines.zh: 你的视线尽头空无一物，唯有虚空与气流在无声地流动。
lines.en: Nothing meets your gaze—only empty space and drifting air flowing without sound.

lines.zh: 你凝望着虚空。然而没有实体阻挡视线，并不意味着这片空间里真正空无一物。
lines.en: You stare into empty air. Yet the absence of solid matter does not mean nothing lingers within that space.

lines.zh: 苍穹、洞穴，抑或仅仅是一段尚未被星辰填满的距离——门扉往往就开启在这般空无之中。
lines.en: Sky, cavern, or merely a span the stars have not yet filled—the Gate most often parts in just such emptiness.

lines.zh: 凡人看不见空气中的低语，正如盲人看不见悬浮在头顶的触须。
lines.en: Mortals cannot see the whispers drifting through the air, any more than the blind see tentacles coiling overhead.

lines.zh: 空旷之处最适合聆听深渊的回响。闭上眼，你便能感知到这片虚无的重量。
lines.en: Open emptiness is the clearest chamber for the echoes of the Abyss. Close your eyes, and feel the weight of this void.

lines.zh: 你的目光落在了{block}之上。即便是最平凡的造物，在深渊眼中也不过是暂存的尘埃。
lines.en: Your gaze rests upon {block}. Even the most ordinary construct is, to the Abyss, merely dust held on loan.

lines.zh: 区区一方{block}，竟也值得你驻足凝视么？凡人的注意力总是如此容易被琐碎之物牵引。
lines.en: Does a mere {block} merit such scrutiny? How easily mortal attention is snared by trivial things.

lines.zh: {block}静静地待在原地，任由时间与风霜侵蚀，直到一切归于混沌。
lines.en: {block} sits motionless in its place, yielding slowly to time and weather until all returns to chaos.

lines.zh: 世间万物皆由微末的粒子拼凑而成，{block}如此，你身上的这具躯壳亦如此。
lines.en: All things in this world are pieced together from fleeting motes—{block} no less than the shell you wear.

lines.zh: 你注视着流动的{block}。流体从不固定形状，正如混沌与沙格斯的躯体。
lines.en: You watch the shifting {block}. Fluidity refuses fixed form—much like Chaos, or the shifting mass of a Shoggoth.

lines.zh: {block}无声地蔓延、渗透一切缝隙，一如禁忌知识在人类心智中的扩散。
lines.en: {block} creeps silently into every crack and seam, just as forbidden lore spreads through a mortal mind.

lines.zh: 液体的表面看似平静，却无人知晓这片{block}之下究竟隐藏着怎样的深浅与暗流。
lines.en: The surface of {block} may look calm, yet none know what depths or dark currents stir beneath.

lines.zh: 你注视着眼前的{block}。水面平静如镜，却照不出潜藏在深海古都中的恐怖。
lines.en: You gaze upon {block}. The surface lies calm as glass, yet reveals none of the terror beneath sunken cities.

lines.zh: 清澈的流水掩盖了水底的幽暗。正如拉莱耶的传说，总是藏在最宁静的海面之下。
lines.en: Clear water masks the abyssal gloom below—just as R'lyeh rests beneath the stillest waves.

lines.zh: {block}看似柔和，一旦掀起狂澜，便能瞬间吞没整座城邦与千百条性命。
lines.en: {block} seems gentle, yet when its fury rises it swallows whole cities and thousands of lives in a breath.

lines.zh: 不要把倒影看得太久，{block}有时会映出本不该站在你身后的东西。
lines.en: Do not stare too long at your reflection; {block} sometimes shows what has no right to stand behind you.

lines.zh: 翻涌的{block}散发着令人窒息的焦热，宛如大地撕裂后露出的炽热内脏。
lines.en: Churning {block} radiates a suffocating heat, like molten entrails spilled from a torn earth.

lines.zh: {block}的红光映照着你的面庞。这般暴烈的物质，倒有几分像地狱或恐惧之地底部的炼狱。
lines.en: The glare of {block} paints your face crimson. Such violent matter recalls the furnaces beneath the Nether or the Dreadlands.

lines.zh: 凡人畏惧{block}的灼痛，却不知在群星之外，有些存在连恒星的内核都能轻易吞咽。
lines.en: Mortals dread the searing touch of {block}, unaware that beyond the stars, beings exist who swallow the hearts of suns.

lines.zh: 一滴{block}便足以让血肉化为焦炭。离它远些，除非你想提前试验这具傀儡的耐受极限。
lines.en: A single splash of {block} reduces flesh to cinder. Keep your distance, unless you wish to test this vessel's limits.

lines.zh: 跳动的{block}在黑暗中摇曳，它能驱散野兽，却永远驱不散宇宙深处的寒意。
lines.en: Flickering {block} dances in the dark; it may ward off beasts, yet it will never drive back the chill of the cosmos.

lines.zh: 你凝望着{block}的光芒。凡人总以为火焰代表文明与安全，殊不知光亮反而会暴露你的轮廓。
lines.en: You watch the glow of {block}. Mortals equate fire with shelter, forgetting that light only silhouettes them for what hunts outside.

lines.zh: {block}贪婪地吞噬着燃料，正如疯狂贪婪地吞噬着理智。
lines.en: {block} devours its fuel greedily, just as madness devours reason.

lines.zh: 岩壁中嵌着尚未开采的{block}。凡人总是热衷于撬开大地的骨骼，去掠夺深埋其中的金属。
lines.en: Unmined {block} gleams within the rock. Mortals are forever eager to pry open the earth's bones for buried metal.

lines.zh: 这脉{block}沉睡在黑暗的岩层里已有千万年，直到你的火把与镐尖惊扰了它的安眠。
lines.en: This vein of {block} has slept in dark strata for millennia, until your torch and pickaxe disturbed its rest.

lines.zh: 挖掘{block}吧，凡人。但要记住，你越是往地底深处掘进，便越接近那些不该被唤醒的东西。
lines.en: Mine your {block}, mortal. Yet remember: the deeper you dig into the stone, the nearer you draw to things better left asleep.

lines.zh: 你看着眼前的{block}。这株脆弱的植物向着阳光伸展，却不知根系正扎在怎样的腐土之上。
lines.en: You look upon {block}. This frail growth reaches for the sun, ignorant of what rot feeds its roots.

lines.zh: {block}生于尘土，枯于寒霜，短短一季便化作腐殖——凡人的寿命在古神眼中亦复如是。
lines.en: {block} springs from dust, withers in frost, and turns to mold in a single season—no different from a mortal span to the Old Ones.

lines.zh: 草木无言，却往往比人类更早察觉到大地深处传来的珊瑚腐化。
lines.en: Plants speak no words, yet they often sense the creeping Coralium blight long before mortals do.

lines.zh: 你看着眼前的{block}。这些曾向天空生长的树木，如今化作了任你驱使的死木。
lines.en: You look upon {block}. Trees that once strained toward the sky now lie reduced to dead timber at your hand.

lines.zh: {block}的年轮记录着几十个寒暑，在凡人眼中或许漫长，在奥穆索却连一眨眼都算不上。
lines.en: The rings of {block} count a few score seasons—long to a mortal, scarcely a blink in Omothol.

lines.zh: 林木在黑暗之地也会扭曲变黑。你面前的{block}，是否还保留着对阳光的记忆？
lines.en: Even timber twists and blackens in the Darklands. Does this {block} still remember the sun?

lines.zh: 你看着面前的{block}。坚硬、沉默、冷酷，宛如宇宙本身对凡人哀求的回应。
lines.en: You look at {block}. Hard, silent, and unfeeling—much like the cosmos itself answering mortal prayers.

lines.zh: {block}构成了这个世界的骨架，然而在旧日支配者的伟力面前，岩石也脆弱得如同薄冰。
lines.en: {block} forms the skeleton of this world; yet before the might of a Great Old One, stone is brittle as thin ice.

lines.zh: 这座世界的一切城垣都由{block}砌成，却没有一堵墙能挡住来自黑暗国度的凝视。
lines.en: Mortals raise every bastion from {block}, yet no wall can bar the gaze of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 用{block}雕刻出神像的蠢货们，往往会在雕像完成的那一刻，听见石头内部传来的笑声。
lines.en: Fools who carve idols out of {block} often hear laughter from inside the stone the moment the chisel stops.

lines.zh: 你盯着脚下的{block}。这层松软的泥土之下，埋葬着多少尚未被发掘的骸骨与遗忘？
lines.en: You stare at the {block} beneath you. How many unexcavated bones and forgotten ages lie buried under this thin crust?

lines.zh: 生命从{block}中汲取养分，最终又腐烂回归其中。多么单调而又卑微的循环。
lines.en: Life draws nourishment from {block}, only to rot back into it at last. How tedious and humble a cycle.

lines.zh: 这方{block}看似寻常，可一旦珊瑚或恐惧的根系扎入其中，整片大地便会瞬间病变。
lines.en: This {block} seems ordinary; yet once Coralium or Dread strikes root within it, the whole earth sickens overnight.

lines.zh: 你凝视着{block}。亿万颗细碎的沙砾堆积在一起，正如时间流逝后留下的冰冷残渣。
lines.en: You gaze at {block}. Countless fine grains heaped together, like the cold residue left behind by passing aeons.

lines.zh: {block}在指缝间滑落，抓得越紧，流失得越快——你的理智也是如此。
lines.en: {block} slips between your fingers; the tighter you clutch it, the faster it runs—just like your sanity.

lines.zh: 在这片{block}之下，是否也曾埋葬过一座早已被史书抹去的无名神庙？
lines.en: Beneath this {block}, might there lie a nameless temple struck from all mortal chronicles?

lines.zh: 你透过{block}向外望去。这层脆弱的晶体给了你安全的错觉，仿佛隔着它便能免受彼岸的侵扰。
lines.en: You peer through {block}. This brittle pane offers the illusion of safety, as though glass could bar what waits beyond.

lines.zh: {block}透明而冰冷，却无法阻止我的目光直接穿透它，落在你的脊背上。
lines.en: {block} is clear and cold, yet it cannot stop my gaze from passing straight through to rest upon your spine.

lines.zh: 凡人用火焰将沙砾炼成{block}，自以为筑起了清晰的边界——可现实的边界又岂是一块玻璃能守住的？
lines.en: Mortals melt sand into {block}, believing they have raised a neat boundary—yet what pane of glass ever held back reality's collapse?

lines.zh: 你盯着面前的{block}。凡人总喜欢把战利品与秘密锁进狭小的盒子里，仿佛这样便能占有它们。
lines.en: You eye the {block} before you. Mortals love to lock spoils and secrets inside cramped vessels, as if that made them truly theirs.

lines.zh: {block}之中究竟藏着救命的器物，还是另一本会招致灾祸的死灵之书？
lines.en: What lies inside {block}—some tool of survival, or another Necronomicon waiting to invite ruin?

lines.zh: 容器可以封存金铁与药草，却永远封不住从门扉之外渗入的疯狂。
lines.en: A chest or vessel may seal away iron and herbs, yet it can never seal out the madness seeping from beyond the Gate.

lines.zh: 你凝视着眼前的{block}。这是深渊的造物，凡俗的工匠永远无法理解它的纹路。
lines.en: You gaze upon {block}. This is a thing wrought of the Abyss; no mortal artisan will ever fathom its grain.

lines.zh: {block}散发着奥穆索与黑暗国度的寒意，仿佛正静静等待着仪式的唤醒。
lines.en: {block} exhales the chill of Omothol and the Dark Realm, as though patiently awaiting a rite to wake it.

lines.zh: 触摸{block}之时，你可曾感觉到其中沉睡的位能正顺着指尖向你涌来？
lines.en: When you touch {block}, do you not feel the Potential Energy slumbering within it surging toward your fingertips?

lines.zh: 这方{block}见证过比人类历史更古老的岁月。莫要用凡俗的眼光去衡量它的价值。
lines.en: This {block} has outlasted ages older than mortal memory. Do not weigh its worth by earthly measures.

lines.zh: 你注视着{block}。那抹诡异的苍蓝正是珊瑚瘟疫的源头，美丽、冰冷而又致命。
lines.en: You gaze upon {block}. That uncanny azure gleam is the wellspring of the Coralium Plague—cold, radiant, and lethal.

lines.zh: {block}在幽暗中泛着微光，宛如深海古都里永不熄灭的鬼火。
lines.en: {block} pulses faintly in the gloom, like undying corpse-lights in a sunken city.

lines.zh: 莫要低估{block}的侵蚀力。它曾将一整片繁荣的疆域化作死寂的深渊荒地。
lines.en: Do not underestimate the rot of {block}. It reduced an entire realm to the dead expanse of the Abyssal Wasteland.

lines.zh: 看着{block}吧，凡人——它是力量，是腐朽，也是阿索拉留给这个世界的毒刺。
lines.en: Behold {block}, mortal—it is power, it is decay, and it is the poisoned barb Asorah left behind.

lines.zh: 你看着面前的{block}。这种诞生于黑暗之地的石材，天生便懂得如何承接奥穆索的位能。
lines.en: You look at {block}. Stone born of the Darklands knows by nature how to drink in the Potential Energy of Omothol.

lines.zh: {block}的纹理深沉而冰冷，仿佛将万古的黑夜直接凝结在了岩石之中。
lines.en: The grain of {block} is deep and frigid, as though ten thousand nights had been frozen solid into rock.

lines.zh: 正是这些冰冷的石块，构筑了通往彼岸的祭坛与雕像。
lines.en: It is from such cold stone that altars and statues to the beyond are hewn.

lines.zh: 你凝视着{block}。这是被恐惧瘟疫彻底浸透、在痛苦中凝结而成的畸变岩层。
lines.en: You gaze upon {block}—warped stone drenched in the Dread Plague and hardened in agony.

lines.zh: {block}的暗红纹路仿佛凝固的血痂，散发着恐惧之地特有的铁锈与焦灼气息。
lines.en: The dark crimson veins of {block} resemble dried scabs, exhaling the rust and char of the Dreadlands.

lines.zh: 这方{block}曾见证过查伽洛斯的咆哮，也承受过无数堕落生灵的哀嚎。
lines.en: This {block} has echoed with the roar of Chagaroth and endured the shrieks of countless twisted things.

lines.zh: 试图开采{block}的凡人，往往在挥镐的同时便已被恐惧的瘴气侵蚀了神智。
lines.en: Mortals who quarry {block} often find their wits eaten away by Dread miasma with every swing of the pick.

lines.zh: 你注视着{block}。渊素是大地深处被深渊气息浸透的结晶，沉重而冰冷。
lines.en: You look upon {block}. Abyssalnite is a crystal forged deep beneath the earth, steeped in the breath of the Abyss—heavy and cold.

lines.zh: {block}闪烁着幽暗的紫芒，恰如黑暗之地地脉中流淌的毒血。
lines.en: {block} glints with a bruised violet sheen, like dark ichor coursing through the veins of the Darklands.

lines.zh: 凡人贪婪地开采{block}以铸造利刃与甲胄，却不知自己正把深渊的印记穿戴在身。
lines.en: Mortals greedily quarry {block} for blades and mail, blind to the fact that they drape themselves in the Abyss's own brand.

lines.zh: 你的双手空空如也。没有武器，没有典籍，唯有这具傀儡的指节在空气中微颤。
lines.en: Your hands are empty. No weapon, no tome—only the knuckles of this simulacrum trembling faintly in the air.

lines.zh: 两手空空地站在深渊的凝视之下，这究竟是绝对的自信，还是彻底的放弃？
lines.en: Standing empty-handed beneath the Abyssal gaze—is this supreme confidence, or utter surrender?

lines.zh: 掌心无物，正适合用来承接从奥穆索降下的第一缕暗影。
lines.en: Empty palms are best suited to receive the first shadow descending from Omothol.

lines.zh: 你未曾握持任何器物。看来你打算仅凭这副借来的威仪去面对前路的险恶了？
lines.en: You wield no tool at all. Do you intend to face the perils ahead with nothing but this borrowed majesty?

lines.zh: 空手而来，空手而去——凡人降生与陨落之时，本就一无所有。
lines.en: Empty-handed you came, empty-handed you shall go—mortals own nothing at birth or at death.

lines.zh: 即便手中没有利刃，你体内的位能与深渊低语也已足够危险。
lines.en: Though your hands hold no steel, the Potential Energy and Abyssal whispers within you are perilous enough.

lines.zh: 你掌中托着{item}。在凡人眼中它或许有用，在旧日支配者眼中却不过是玩具般的碎屑。
lines.en: You hold {item}. To mortal eyes it may seem useful; to a Great Old One it is mere toy-like dross.

lines.zh: 你如此珍视手中的{item}，莫非以为它真能护你周全？
lines.en: You cling so tightly to {item}—do you truly believe it can keep you whole?

lines.zh: 区区一件{item}，又能替你抵挡几分来自星海之外的恶意？
lines.en: How much malice from beyond the stars can a mere {item} ward off?

lines.zh: 器物终究只是器物。真正决定生死的，是握住{item}的那颗心智是否已经彻底疯癫。
lines.en: A tool is only a tool. What decides life or death is whether the mind clutching {item} has already snapped.

lines.zh: 你横握着{item}。锋利的剑刃渴望着饮血，正如恐惧之地渴望着新的亡魂。
lines.en: You hold {item} at the ready. Its keen edge thirsts for blood, just as the Dreadlands thirst for fresh shades.

lines.zh: 这柄{item}或许能斩杀僵尸与食尸鬼，但在面对真正的旧日支配者时，它与一根枯枝毫无区别。
lines.en: This {item} may hew down zombies and ghouls; yet against a true Great Old One, it is no better than a dry twig.

lines.zh: {item}的刃面映出你冷峻的轮廓。记住，屠戮怪物之人，往往最先在血腥中失去人形。
lines.en: The blade of {item} mirrors your cold silhouette. Remember: those who slaughter monsters are often first to shed their humanity.

lines.zh: 挥动{item}去战斗吧，凡人。让我看看这具空心傀儡究竟能收割多少性命。
lines.en: Swing {item} and fight, mortal. Let me see how many lives this hollow puppet can reap.

lines.zh: 你拉起{item}，将杀意凝聚在弦端，企图从远方安全地收割性命。
lines.en: You draw {item}, gathering lethal intent upon the string to reap lives from afar.

lines.zh: 箭矢破空而去，看似迅捷，然则在萨克索斯面前，凡俗的弹射物根本伤不到他分毫。
lines.en: Arrows fly swift through the air—yet before Sacthoth, mortal projectiles cannot scratch him at all.

lines.zh: {item}是猎手与懦夫共同喜爱的兵器——既能精准穿心，又不必直面猎物临死前的眼神。
lines.en: {item} is favored by hunter and coward alike—it pierces the heart without forcing you to meet your quarry's dying gaze.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着{item}。凡人依靠工具改造世界，却不知世界早已在暗中改造了你们。
lines.en: You hold {item}. Mortals rely on tools to reshape the world, blind to how the world has already reshaped them.

lines.zh: 这件{item}是你意志的延伸，帮助你开辟道路、采集资源，只为走得更远、堕落得更深。
lines.en: This {item} is an extension of your will, clearing paths and gathering spoils so you may wander farther and fall deeper.

lines.zh: 器物虽小，却承载着生存的执念。继续用{item}去撬动你眼前的阻碍吧。
lines.en: Small though {item} may be, it bears the stubborn will to survive. Use it to pry aside whatever bars your way.

lines.zh: 你握着{item}，用这冰冷的镐尖敲碎岩石，向着大地最幽暗的腹地掘进。
lines.en: You grip {item}, shattering stone with its cold point to burrow into the darkest belly of the earth.

lines.zh: {item}每一次落下，都在剥开世界的外壳。小心，地下深处并非只有矿脉与宝石。
lines.en: Every strike of {item} peels back the crust of the world. Beware—more than ore and gems sleeps below.

lines.zh: {item}能凿穿黑曜石与渊素，却凿不穿横亘在凡人与外神之间的鸿沟。
lines.en: {item} may crack obsidian and Abyssalnite, yet it cannot breach the gulf between mortals and Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 你握紧了{item}。这柄利斧既能劈开林木，也能劈开阻挡在前路的血肉与骨殖。
lines.en: You grip {item}. This blade cleaves timber and bone alike—anything foolish enough to bar your path.

lines.zh: 挥舞{item}的动作干脆而残暴，倒颇有几分黑暗领域狂信徒的作风。
lines.en: The swing of {item} is blunt and brutal, worthy of a zealot of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: {item}的刃口闪烁着寒光。树木在它面前倒下，敌人在它面前溅血。
lines.en: The edge of {item} gleams cold. Trees fall before it, and foes spill blood.

lines.zh: 你拿着{item}，准备将这微不足道的尘世养料塞入腹中。
lines.en: You hold {item}, ready to stuff that trivial earthly fare into your belly.

lines.zh: 血肉之躯真是可悲，竟需要不断吞咽{item}来阻止自己枯萎腐烂。
lines.en: How pitiful is mortal flesh, needing to swallow {item} without end merely to keep from withering.

lines.zh: 享用你的{item}吧，凡人。在真正的疯狂降临之前，至少还能尝到些许味觉。
lines.en: Take your {item}, mortal. Before true madness descends, at least you may still taste something.

lines.zh: {item}能填饱凡俗的胃囊，却永远填不满灵魂对禁忌知识的饥渴。
lines.en: {item} may fill a mortal belly, yet it will never sate a soul starving for forbidden lore.

lines.zh: 你手中拿着{item}。钢铁与皮革能挡住凡俗的爪牙，却挡不住渗透灵魂的疯狂。
lines.en: You hold {item}. Iron and hide may turn earthly claws, yet they cannot turn madness from your soul.

lines.zh: 凡人总喜欢用{item}将自己层层包裹，仿佛厚重的甲片便能带来安宁。
lines.en: Mortals love to encase themselves in {item}, as though heavy plates could purchase peace of mind.

lines.zh: 穿戴上{item}吧。在恐惧之地与深渊荒地，一丝一毫的防护都可能决定你是生是死。
lines.en: Don {item} then. In the Dreadlands and Abyssal Wasteland, every scrap of ward decides whether you live or fall.

lines.zh: 你手中晃动着一瓶{item}。玻璃瓶里封存着炼金术士们用草药与魔力调制的虚妄安慰。
lines.en: You swirl a vial of {item}—ephemeral comfort brewed from herbs and alchemy within fragile glass.

lines.zh: 一口{item}或许能暂时止住伤痛或赋予蛮力，却治不好你灵魂上日益加深的裂缝。
lines.en: A draught of {item} may dull pain or lend fleeting vigor, yet it cannot mend the widening cracks in your soul.

lines.zh: 这瓶{item}的色泽在幽暗中显得格外诡异，不知饮下之后究竟是救赎还是另一种毒药。
lines.en: The hue of {item} glints strangely in the gloom; who knows whether it brings relief or a subtler poison?

lines.zh: 你捧着{item}。文字是凡人用来束缚知识的牢笼，然而真正的恐怖从不肯乖乖留在纸页之间。
lines.en: You hold {item}. Words are the cage mortals build for knowledge, yet true horror refuses to stay pinned to the page.

lines.zh: 翻开{item}吧。每一行墨迹背后，或许都藏着某个早已发疯的抄写员最后的呻吟。
lines.en: Open {item}. Behind every line of ink may hide the final groan of some scribe who lost his wits.

lines.zh: 你在阅读{item}，而黑暗之中，也有无数双眼睛正透过书页反过来阅读着你。
lines.en: You read {item}, while in the dark countless eyes read you back through the very pages.

lines.zh: 你手中握着{item}——一件沾染了深渊气息与禁忌位能的造物。
lines.en: You hold {item}—an artifact steeped in Abyssal breath and forbidden Potential Energy.

lines.zh: {item}正在你的掌心微微震颤，仿佛认出了这具傀儡身上属于扎哈尔的残响。
lines.en: {item} trembles faintly in your palm, as if recognizing the echo of J'zahar within this simulacrum.

lines.zh: 唯有踏足过黑暗与绝望的探索者，才配将{item}握在手中。
lines.en: Only an explorer who has walked through darkness and despair is fit to wield {item}.

lines.zh: 善用{item}吧，凡人。它是你在珊瑚与恐惧之间披荆斩棘的依凭，也是你越陷越深的证明。
lines.en: Wield {item} well, mortal. It is your edge against Coralium and Dread—and proof of how deep you have waded.

lines.zh: 你手中紧握着{item}！正是我的典籍指引着无数疯狂的灵魂一路走到今日。
lines.en: You clutch {item}! It is my readings that have led countless maddened souls all the way here.

lines.zh: 没有了{item}，你便毫无价值，凡人。好好倾听这本黑皮书页间渗出的阿克洛语低吟吧。
lines.en: Without {item}, you are worthless, mortal. Listen well to the Aklo whispers seeping from its dark pages.

lines.zh: 每一次翻动{item}，你的神智便会不可逆转地滑向奥穆索的深渊。
lines.en: Every turn of {item}'s pages slides your mind irreversibly closer to the abyss of Omothol.

lines.zh: {item}记录着仪式、位能与旧日支配者的真名。莫要让它落入不配触碰它的愚人手中。
lines.en: {item} holds rituals, Potential Energy, and the true names of the Great Old Ones. Never let it fall into unworthy hands.

lines.zh: Iä! {item}在你掌中发烫——它认出了这具化身背后真正的主人。
lines.en: Iä! {item} warms in your grasp—it knows the true master behind this simulacrum.

lines.zh: 继续研读{item}吧，直到你再也分不清现实与疯狂的界限。
lines.en: Read on in {item}, until you can no longer tell reality from madness.

lines.zh: 你的副手悄然握持着备用的器物。在瞬息万变的险境中，多一份准备便多一线生机。
lines.en: Your offhand quietly holds a spare tool ready. In shifting peril, one extra preparation may buy another breath.

lines.zh: 双手并用，方能应对深渊生物从死角袭来的扑杀。
lines.en: Both hands engaged—only so can you meet the ambush of Abyssal horrors from your blind side.

lines.zh: 副手中的器物沉默待命，恰如潜伏在主世界阴影里的第二道防线。
lines.en: What rests in your offhand waits in silence, like a second ward lurking in the shadows.

lines.zh: {block}并非死物——在旧日支配者的疆域里，连石块与金属都携带着一丝狂乱的意志。
lines.en: {block} is no dead matter; within the domains of the Great Old Ones, even stone and ore carry a sliver of mad will.

lines.zh: Iä! 将{block}置于你的视野之中，是否让你听见了彼岸传来的低沉共鸣？
lines.en: Iä! Holding {block} within your sight—do you hear the low resonance answering from beyond the Gate?

lines.zh: 唯有足够坚韧的器具，才能撼动{block}的矿脉——正如唯有疯狂的心智，才能承载禁忌的真理。
lines.en: Only hardened tools can crack a vein of {block}—just as only a hardened mind can bear forbidden truth.

lines.zh: 这{block}之中凝聚着古老的位能，令死灵之书的持有者趋之若鹜。
lines.en: Within {block} gathers ancient Potential Energy, coveted by every bearer of the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: 仔细端详{block}的断面吧，那幽暗的色泽宛如奥穆索永夜的缩影。
lines.en: Study the fracture of {block}; its somber hue mirrors the perpetual night of Omothol.

lines.zh: 面前并无障碍，可你的前路真的如眼前这片空气一般坦荡么？
lines.en: No wall bars your sight—yet is your path truly as clear as the air before you?

lines.zh: 风穿过这片空隙，带来极远处某个未知维度的微弱震颤。
lines.en: Wind slips through this empty span, carrying the faint tremor of some distant, unnamed realm.

lines.zh: 即便眼中只有一片空明，黑暗国度的阴影也依然紧贴在你的视野边缘。
lines.en: Though your eyes meet only open air, the shadow of the Dark Realm still clings to the rim of your sight.

lines.zh: 看着{block}吧。无论凡人将它砌成高墙还是祭坛，终有一日都会在群星归位时化为齑粉。
lines.en: Look upon {block}. Whether mortals lay it into fortress walls or altars, all shall crumble when the stars are right.

lines.zh: 这方{block}并未开口，它只是沉默地见证着又一个疯子从自己面前走过。
lines.en: This {block} speaks no word; it merely bears silent witness as another madman passes before it.

lines.zh: 打开{block}之前，先问问自己：你真的准备好清点里面沉睡的东西了么？
lines.en: Before you unlatch {block}, ask yourself whether you are truly ready to count what sleeps within.

lines.zh: 这方{block}装得下凡世的财宝，却装不下一位旧日支配者的哪怕一丝凝视。
lines.en: This {block} can hold earthly trinkets, yet cannot contain a single flicker of a Great Old One's gaze.

lines.zh: 沉重的{block}守卫着你的积蓄，正如恐惧守卫着查伽洛斯的巢穴。
lines.en: Sturdy {block} guards your hoard, much as Dread guards the lair of Chagaroth.

lines.zh: 若没有足够的防护便长时间靠近{block}，你的血肉迟早会染上同样的苍蓝。
lines.en: Linger too long beside {block} without ward, and your flesh will take on that same sickly blue.

lines.zh: Iä! {block}之中蕴含的异界能量，正是锻造深渊器具不可或缺的基石。
lines.en: Iä! The alien potency locked within {block} is the very cornerstone of Abyssal craft.

lines.zh: 凡人用{block}筑起神殿，却往往在建成之日才发觉自己不过是在为外神修建牢笼之外的走廊。
lines.en: Mortals raise shrines of {block}, realizing too late that they have only built corridors for the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 这方{block}沉默地吸收着周围的微光，令一切尘世的喧嚣在它面前黯然失色。
lines.en: This {block} drinks in the surrounding light, dimming every earthly clamor before its presence.

lines.zh: 敲开{block}的岩层，你听见的不是回音，而是黑暗领域深处传来的低沉脉动。
lines.en: Strike a seam of {block}, and what answers is no echo—only the slow pulse of the Dark Realm far below.

lines.zh: 凡人终其一生都在{block}之上奔忙，到头来也不过是替自己多占了一捧坟土。
lines.en: Mortals scurry across {block} all their lives, only to claim a single handful of grave-earth at the end.

lines.zh: 踩在{block}上时，莫要忘了你脚底几丈之下，或许正有沙格斯在泥岩间蠕动。
lines.en: Treading {block}, do not forget that fathoms below your boots a Shoggoth may even now be churning through the mire.

lines.zh: {block}能掩埋尸体，却掩埋不了死灵之书里记载的禁忌过往。
lines.en: {block} may cover corpses, yet it cannot bury the forbidden past inscribed in the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: 雨水将{block}化作泥泞，正如绝望将凡人的意志泡软。
lines.en: Rain turns {block} to mud, just as despair softens a mortal will.

lines.zh: 连这卑微的{block}，在群星归位之时也会在虚空的狂风中化为乌有。
lines.en: Even this lowly {block} shall scatter into nothingness before the gales of the Void when the stars are right.

lines.zh: {block}冰冷而坚硬，恰似这片受诅咒的维度对所有生者怀抱的恶意。
lines.en: {block} is cold and unyielding, like the malice this accursed realm bears toward all living things.

lines.zh: 看着{block}吧——连石头都能被恐惧扭曲至此，区区血肉之躯又能撑得住几时？
lines.en: Look upon {block}—if stone itself can be warped so far by Dread, how long can mere flesh endure?

lines.zh: 在{block}的灰烬落定之后，留下的唯有比从前更加深沉的黑暗。
lines.en: When the embers of {block} cool to ash, what remains is a darkness deeper than before.

lines.zh: 纵使是炽烈的{block}，在黑暗国度那绝对的虚暗面前，也会在一瞬间熄灭。
lines.en: Even fierce {block} snuffs out in an instant before the absolute gloom of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: {block}的爆裂声中，仿佛夹杂着某种古老祭坛上牺牲者的低泣。
lines.en: Amid the crackle of {block}, one almost hears the faint weeping of offerings upon an ancient altar.

lines.zh: 只需轻轻一击，{block}便会化作满地锋利的碎片，一如你那不堪一击的理智。
lines.en: One sharp blow shatters {block} into jagged splinters, brittle as your own sanity.

lines.zh: 在{block}模糊的反光里，你看到的究竟是自己的脸，还是奥穆索守门人的面容？
lines.en: In the faint reflection of {block}, do you see your own face—or the visage of the Gatekeeper of Omothol?

lines.zh: 隔着{block}观望世界，倒很符合你如今披着这具傀儡时的姿态——既在其中，又在之外。
lines.en: Watching the world through {block} suits your current state well enough—inside the frame, yet severed from it.

lines.zh: 在{block}缓慢流动的粘稠表面下，仿佛正沉睡着某种不惧烈焰的古老怪物。
lines.en: Beneath the viscous, creeping crust of {block}, something ancient and impervious to flame seems to slumber.

lines.zh: 炽热的{block}吞噬一切坠落之物，不留骸骨，亦不留遗言。
lines.en: Seething {block} consumes all that falls within, leaving neither bone nor epitaph.

lines.zh: 莫要轻易将手伸入未知的{block}——在深渊的疆域里，液体往往比刀剑更致命。
lines.en: Do not dip your hand lightly into unknown {block}—within Abyssal domains, liquids kill more surely than steel.

lines.zh: {block}随重力流淌，寻找着最低洼的归宿，恰似堕落的灵魂总会滑向深渊。
lines.en: {block} seeks the lowest hollow, just as fallen souls inevitably slide toward the Abyss.

lines.zh: 凝望{block}的波纹吧，那晃动的倒影正悄悄扭曲着你对现实的认知。
lines.en: Stare into the ripples of {block}; its wavering reflection quietly warps your hold on reality.

lines.zh: {block}不过是造物主遗落在石缝里的碎屑，却足以让无数凡人为之互相残杀。
lines.en: {block} is mere dross left in stone fissures, yet mortals slaughter one another over its gleam.

lines.zh: 金属与矿石只能铸造凡俗的器物，唯有深渊的位能才能撼动界域的门扉。
lines.en: Ore and metal forge only earthly tools; only the Potential Energy of the Abyss can shake the Gates between worlds.

lines.zh: 你盯着{block}时眼中的贪欲，与那些最终沦为深渊矿奴的愚人别无二致。
lines.en: The hunger in your eyes as you look upon {block} differs not at all from the fools who ended as thralls in the deep.

lines.zh: 这株{block}在微风中轻轻摇曳，仿佛正在向某个看不见的存在俯首致意。
lines.en: This {block} sways gently in the breeze, as though bowing before an unseen presence.

lines.zh: 即便是最不起眼的{block}，在恐惧瘟疫降临时也会扭曲成可怖的畸形。
lines.en: Even the humblest {block} warps into grotesque shapes when the Dread Plague sweeps past.

lines.zh: 花叶终会凋零，唯有雕刻在黑石上的死灵之书符文永恒不朽。
lines.en: Leaf and bloom alike must fade; only the glyphs of the Necronomicon carved in dark stone endure.

lines.zh: 干燥的{block}不留水痕，亦不留脚印。风吹过之后，一切仿佛从未发生。
lines.en: Dry {block} keeps neither water nor footprint. Once the wind passes, it is as though you were never there.

lines.zh: 沙漏里的{block}正在一点点坠落。凡人啊，你距离终局还剩多少时间？
lines.en: The {block} in the hourglass trickles downward grain by grain. How much time remains to you, mortal?

lines.zh: 每一粒{block}都是岩石风化后的尸骸。
lines.en: Every grain of {block} is the weathered corpse of ancient stone.

lines.zh: 这方{block}承受了千万年的重压，依然沉默不语。你比它又能多坚持几分？
lines.en: This {block} has endured the crushing weight of ages in silence. How much longer can you endure than stone?

lines.zh: 岩层深处并非只有死寂的{block}——那里还隐藏着黑暗之地与珊瑚的矿脉。
lines.en: The deep strata hold more than lifeless {block}—there too hide veins of Coralium and Darkstone.

lines.zh: 哪怕将{block}凿成密不透风的墓室，死亡与疯狂依然会从石缝中渗入。
lines.en: Even if you hew {block} into an airtight vault, death and madness still seep through the seams.

lines.zh: {block}冰冷的触感，恰好提醒着你这具傀儡并非血肉之躯。
lines.en: The cold touch of {block} serves to remind you that this simulacrum is no true flesh.

lines.zh: 水波荡漾着微光，恰似珊瑚瘟疫在夜晚的海面上悄然蔓延的模样。
lines.en: Ripples shimmer faintly, like the Coralium Plague spreading silently across night-darkened waves.

lines.zh: 凡人离不开{block}的滋养，却也随时可能溺毙在它的怀抱里。
lines.en: Mortals cannot live without {block}, yet may drown in its embrace at any hour.

lines.zh: 凡人用{block}搭建屋檐与门扉，以为木板便能将黑夜中的怪物拒之门外。
lines.en: Mortals build roofs and doors of {block}, trusting planks of wood to bar the horrors of the night.

lines.zh: {block}极易燃烧，也极易腐朽。将希望寄托于此等脆弱之物，实在可笑。
lines.en: {block} burns easily and rots quicker still. How absurd to rest one's shelter on so frail a thing.

lines.zh: 砍向{block}的斧声惊扰了林间的寂静，也惊动了树根下沉睡的阴影。
lines.en: The axe biting into {block} shatters the woodland hush—and wakes the shadows sleeping beneath the roots.

lines.zh: {block}的木纹蜿蜒曲折，宛如深渊之书页边那些令人目眩的几何图案。
lines.en: The grain of {block} twists in dizzying curves, like the geometries scrawled in the margins of the Abyssalnomicon.

lines.zh: 这方{block}终将化为灰烬或尘土，唯有虚空永恒长存。
lines.en: This {block} shall turn to ash or dust at last; only the Void endures.

lines.zh: 这件{item}散发出的冰冷威压，令寻常的凡俗兵器相形见绌。
lines.en: The cold weight of {item} puts ordinary earthly blades to shame.

lines.zh: Iä! {item}既是工具，亦是契约——它时刻提醒着你与深渊之间早已无法割舍的联系。
lines.en: Iä! {item} is both instrument and pact, forever reminding you of the bond you can no longer sever with the Abyss.

lines.zh: 你把玩着{item}，却忘了在奥穆索，一切物质最终都会化作虚无。
lines.en: You turn {item} over in your hand, forgetting that in Omothol all matter dissolves at last into nothingness.

lines.zh: 无论你携带多少{item}，都填不满灵魂深处那道因窥探真理而裂开的空洞。
lines.en: No matter how many {item} you carry, none can fill the chasm torn in your soul by forbidden truth.

lines.zh: 这件{item}或许能替这具空心傀儡多撑过几次撕咬，仅此而已。
lines.en: This {item} may spare your hollow puppet a few more bites—nothing more.

lines.zh: 铠甲再坚固，也护不住你自己主动向深渊敞开的心门。
lines.en: No armor, however stout, can guard a mind that throws its own doors open to the Abyss.

lines.zh: 沉重的{item}压在身上，恰似你背负的禁忌知识般令人喘不过气。
lines.en: The weight of {item} presses down, heavy as the forbidden lore you carry.

lines.zh: 砍伐、劈裂、摧毁——{item}的存在本身便充满了原始的暴力。
lines.en: Hew, split, shatter—{item} embodies a crude, primal violence.

lines.zh: 小心莫让{item}的刃口卷曲在黑暗之地的硬木之上，亦莫让它沾染了不该斩杀的鲜血。
lines.en: Take care {item} does not notch against Darklands timber—or drink blood better left unspilled.

lines.zh: 锋利的{item}能斩断树木的根基，却斩不断深渊盘踞在世界深处的触须。
lines.en: Keen {item} may sever a tree from its roots, yet it cannot sever the Abyss's tendrils from the world's core.

lines.zh: 凡人总以为把秘密写进{item}里就能流传万世，殊不知有些书卷本身便是招致毁灭的信标。
lines.en: Mortals think writing secrets into {item} preserves wisdom, blind to the fact that some volumes are beacons of ruin.

lines.zh: 纸张脆弱易焚，唯有铭刻在{item}里的狂乱思想能跨越纪元而不朽。
lines.en: Paper is frail and burns easily; only the mad thoughts inscribed in {item} outlive the ages.

lines.zh: 这本{item}或许记载了些许尘世的奥秘，但比起奥穆索的典籍，仍显得浅薄可笑。
lines.en: This {item} may hold a few earthly secrets, yet beside the tomes of Omothol it reads like a child's primer.

lines.zh: 弓弦紧绷的震颤，恰似理智在彻底崩断前发出的最后一声哀鸣。
lines.en: The taut hum of the bowstring sounds like sanity's last whine before it snaps.

lines.zh: 无论你的{item}射得有多远，都射不穿群星之间那片冰冷的虚空。
lines.en: No matter how far your {item} looses its shaft, it will never cross the cold void between the stars.

lines.zh: 稳住你的呼吸，否则握着{item}的手哪怕颤抖半分，箭矢便会偏离靶心。
lines.en: Steady your breath, lest the hand holding {item} tremble and send the arrow wide.

lines.zh: 在深渊荒地与恐惧之地，连最寻常的{item}都显得像是一种奢侈的慰藉。
lines.en: In the Abyssal Wasteland and Dreadlands, even plain {item} feels like a rare comfort.

lines.zh: 吞下{item}之时，莫要忘了你迟早也会成为其他存在眼中的食粮。
lines.en: As you swallow {item}, do not forget that in time you too are fodder in the eyes of greater things.

lines.zh: 左掌与右掌各自承接着不同的使命，正如理智与疯狂在你的脑海中彼此拉扯。
lines.en: Left hand and right each bear their own duty, much as sanity and madness tug against one another in your skull.

lines.zh: 多备一件器物在手边总归无害——只要你别在慌乱中忘了自己究竟握着什么。
lines.en: Keeping an extra tool at the ready does no harm—so long as panic does not make you forget what you hold.

lines.zh: 这副手里的筹码，或许能在关键时刻替你挡下致命的一击。
lines.en: That reserve in your offhand might yet turn aside a fatal blow when the hour strikes.

lines.zh: 矿洞里的回声随着{item}的挥动不断扩散，谁知道黑暗的另一头有什么东西听见了这声响？
lines.en: Echoes ripple through the cavern with every swing of {item}; who knows what hears them in the dark beyond?

lines.zh: 挥动{item}吧，掘墓人。你挖掘的每一条矿道，都可能成为通往深渊的阶梯。
lines.en: Swing {item}, gravedigger. Every tunnel you carve may become a stair leading down to the Abyss.

lines.zh: {item}终究会磨损，正如你的精力会在无尽的挖掘中消耗殆尽。
lines.en: {item} wears down in time, just as your strength drains away in endless toil.

lines.zh: 凡人总是寄希望于这一小瓶{item}，仿佛几口液体便能逆转既定的命运。
lines.en: Mortals pin so much hope on a tiny phial of {item}, as if a few swallows could overturn doom.

lines.zh: 拔开瓶塞之前，先确认这{item}里没有混入来自珊瑚沼泽的污秽。
lines.en: Before you unstopper {item}, make sure no taint from the Coralium swamps was stirred into the brew.

lines.zh: 药水终有饮尽之时，而深渊的凝视永不枯竭。
lines.en: Every phial empties at last, whereas the gaze of the Abyss never runs dry.

lines.zh: {item}出鞘的寒鸣，正是死灵之书之外另一种简洁的语言。
lines.en: The cold ring of {item} drawn from its sheath is a blunt tongue, simpler than the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: 莫要让{item}在关键时刻脱手——在黑暗国度里，失去武器便等同于献出咽喉。
lines.en: Do not let {item} slip in the decisive instant; in the Dark Realm, dropping your blade is offering your throat.

lines.zh: 无论{item}多么精良，也无法修理一颗已被深渊真相震碎的心智。
lines.en: However finely wrought {item} may be, it cannot repair a mind shattered by the truth of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 握紧你的{item}。在这充满敌意的诸界之中，唯有手中的依凭不会背叛你。
lines.en: Hold fast to {item}. Across these hostile realms, at least the tool in your hand will not betray you.

lines.zh: {item}的磨损记录着你的跋涉，正如伤痕记录着你的狂妄。
lines.en: The wear upon {item} records your long march, just as scars record your pride.
